system.description: Your body never stopped decaying after the Embrace. Whenever you take damage, make a Static Test; on a loss, the damage becomes aggravated due to your accelerated decay. You stink something awful, too: wear a tag whenever your true form is visible, proclaiming that you look and smell like a rotting corpse out of a B-grade horror movie.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
